_comment: MUTATION-TIERED-ROLLOUT-1. Thresholds live HERE, not in a script or a checklist (SO #41) — run-mutation-tier.mjs and chaingraph/kernels/mutation-tier-split.mjs read this file, never hardcode a floor. Generalizes FV-STRYKER-PILOT-1 (board/done/FV-STRYKER-PILOT-1.md, research/FV-STRYKER-PILOT-1-REPORT.md) from a 10-kernel pilot to risk-tiered estate thresholds.
moneyMathBreakFloor_comment: Target stated at staging was 95%, 'calibrate against pilot data'. Re-running the pilot's own 10 kernels with the tier split applied (excluding buildArtifact()/meta, which the pilot's report identified as structurally uncoverable by a floor that imports only compute()) measured a money-math-only average of 90.9% and a minimum of 84.7% (art-06) across the 10 BEFORE any new test authoring. 95% was not reachable without touching sealed/frozen proptest assumptions on every one of the 10 in one row, so the floor is calibrated to 90 (below the measured floor-improved average, above the pre-improvement minimum) with per-kernel scores quoted in the row check-off; 95% remains the aspirational target for future ratchet-up rows once broader estate data exists. This is a ratchet-up floor, never lowered silently (SO #41) — raising it is a future row's job once the full-estate nightly scan has run enough cycles to know what's holdable broadly, not just across the original 10.
peripheralBreakFloor_comment: Holdable floor per staging note. Measured pilot-10 peripheral (buildArtifact()/meta) average was ~0% pre-existing (proptest floors never exercise that code by design) — this tier is not expected to pass today. See 'peripheralGateMode' below: it is measured and reported on every run, but does not fail the gate until dedicated buildArtifact()/meta coverage exists (a separate, out-of-fence follow-up; see FINDINGS-HELD-2026-08 per SO #42(c) discipline).
peripheralGateMode_comment: advisory | enforced. While advisory, a peripheral-tier score below peripheralBreakFloor is printed and included in every summary but does NOT fail run-mutation-tier.mjs's exit code. Flip to 'enforced' once buildArtifact()/meta gets its own dedicated test coverage (tracked, not solved, in this row per its scope-discipline clause: 'note the question, do not solve it').

excludedKernels.art-594-tempo-mpp-voucher-receipt-verifi: Non-canonical export shape (`export { compute, meta };` at EOF instead of `export function compute`/`export function buildArtifact`) — chaingraph/kernels/mutation-tier-split.mjs cannot locate an envelope split line, so this kernel is excluded rather than guessed (SO #34c). Also a ~6,100-line bundled-Noble-crypto file and the estate's one SLOW-class kernel (GPU-CYCLE-PREFLIGHT-SPEC.md, in-guest signature verification) — mutation testing it is a separate, disproportionate undertaking. Named exception, not attempted this row.
